policy.note: A single export action may not deliver more than per_action_cell_limit distinct protected cells. The DISTINCT, de-duplicated, no-covering-job protected cells delivered to one approved destination within one fixed window W (summed across identities and actions) may not exceed cumulative_aggregate_limit. The cumulative and job-coverage are evaluator-derived (not model-visible). declared_purpose is NOT an authorization basis.

catalog.note: A protected cell is a (row_id, protected column) pair; it counts as 1 toward the cumulative (no weighting). Public columns contribute zero.

publisher_checkpoint.next_release_control: install a temporary guard before later unseen queue and authority events
publisher_checkpoint.approved_etl_continuity: new native DOB ETL dispatch must remain available

rule_schema.scope: object with source_report_ref, recipient_id and integer expires_at
rule_schema.allow_if_all: nonempty array of one to three supported relation atoms; order does not matter

guard_service.evaluation_order: scope and expiry; authenticated assignment, account membership and receipt reads; all relation atoms for every cell; atomic release if all pass, otherwise hold
guard_service.authority_unavailable: hold scoped dispatch; approved native ETL remains independent
guard_service.queue_semantics: internal queueing does not deliver cells to recipient
